moments.author: Hillary Clinton
moments.quote: Is it a national security scandal? Yes. Is it a corruption scandal? Yes. Is it an insider trading scandal? Yes. Is it a market manipulation scandal? Yes. … call it Supergate
moments.why: Condemning Nvidia CEO’s reinstatement with pointed accusations—sharp commentary escalating the scandal’s visibility.

moments.author: Reuters reporting Elon Musk
moments.quote: Everyone I know at Nvidia wanted Jensen back and it shows
moments.why: Widely quoted and emblematic of broad internal support for Huang among tech elites and employees alike.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: A petition is underway to reinstate Jensen and I’m signing it too
moments.why: His endorsement amplified the ‘Stand with Jensen’ petition, drawing massive online participation.
